title: 10 Best Ammi Visnaga Preparations

Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb using alcohol as a solvent, enhancing bioavailability. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substance, are used for their soothing and emollient properties. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized way to consume the herb, making it accessible for modern wellness routines.
